solo-hello.text: You pick up the guitar, or warm up your voice, and then wonder what to practise. attunr answers that every day, with a practice plan made for you. It opens in your browser, with nothing to install.

solo-questions.text: It starts with you. Say what you play or sing, where you are today, and how many minutes a day you have. Nobody is tested, and a first week is a fine place to start.

solo-today.text: From then on, you never start by wondering what to play. Open the plan and today's practice is ready: what to work on, and for how long. It comes from a library of exercises, and each day is a bit different from the day before.

solo-exercise.text: These are not pages to read. Every exercise plays with you and listens to you. See the notes on a guitar neck. Play along with a tab. Watch your own voice on the staff as you sing, with a band behind you.

solo-rate.text: After each exercise you say how it went, from Can't do it yet to Easy now. That is all the plan needs. The next plan brings the next thing within reach, and mixes back a little of what already feels solid.

solo-habit.text: A short practice every day takes you further than a long one now and then. So you get a daily reminder at the time you choose, a timer for the day's practice and a day streak. There are no points and no score. Progress is what gets easier to play or sing.

solo-end.text: Practise every day, know what to play, and hear it get easier. attunr is in beta, and it is free now. The first people who sign up get the early price when paid plans open, and that price is locked in.

teach-hello.text: You teach the lesson. What happens in the days until the next one? attunr is a web app for music teachers and schools. You give each student a week of practice and a lesson note, and they practise with them at home.

teach-student.text: Getting a student started is quick. Add them by name and email, and answer a few questions about what they play and where they are. The student gets a link by email, and their first week is ready.

teach-week.text: Each week is seven days of short exercises, chosen for that student from a library of exercises. Nothing is left to work out at home: the exact material is on the page. This scale, in this key, in this position. So the minutes they practise count for more.

teach-next.text: You stay the teacher. After each exercise the student rates how it went, so you see how the week really was. Before the next week, you set where the student is now, one slider for each topic, and the next plan follows you both.

teach-notes.text: A lesson note puts today's lesson on one page the student can play: text, a scale on the neck, chord boxes and a melody. Change the key, and the whole page follows it. Then it goes to the student as a link, so the lesson comes home with them.

teach-partners.text: attunr is still being built, and that is your chance to shape it. It is looking for founding partners: teachers and schools who use it early and say what gets built first. In return, a founding partner gets a long trial and a locked-in price.

teach-end.text: See it for yourself. The demos work today, with no account. Open a student's week, or book a video call with the founder and see it working with what you teach.
